gaps.title: Solid materials
gaps.text: No solid-material test falls inside this band. Of 264 solid-fuel tests in PSI tables, 140 record oxygen (highest 22.2%) and 0 record pressure. 62 match the oxygen band only.

gaps.title: Tests inside the band
gaps.text: 192 tests with both oxygen and pressure inside the band: 84 droplet, 108 gas, 0 solid.

gaps.title: Smoke detection
gaps.text: The 117 smoke-aerosol tests (SAME, SAME-R, DAFT) tabulate air flow and material, but no oxygen or pressure, so they cannot be placed in any atmosphere band.

gaps.title: ACME BRE (per-day listing)
gaps.text: ACME BRE lists oxygen levels of 21.0%, 25.0%, 26.5%, 34.0%, 40.0% per test day; per-test conditions and pressures are not in the summary table.

gaps.title: FLEX-2 (per-day listing)
gaps.text: FLEX-2 lists oxygen levels of 17.0%, 21.0%, 25.0%, 30.0% per test day; per-test conditions and pressures are not in the summary table.

cabin.headline: 192 tests sit inside the cabin band. Solid-material tests reach 22% oxygen but do not record pressure; 62 of them match on oxygen alone.

canned.q: Which investigations matter most for a Moon base?
canned.a:
For Moon / Mars base and pressurized rover (28% to 40% O2, 50 to 72 kPa), the investigations rank as follows:
1. FLEX [[inv:PSI-69]]: score 0.97 (direct 1.0, conditions 1.0, evidence 0.893). 12 tests inside the O2 and pressure band.
2. ACME CFI-G [[inv:PSI-159]]: score 0.84 (direct 0.6, conditions 1.0, evidence 1.0). 26 tests inside the O2 and pressure band.
3. SAME-R [[inv:PSI-101]]: score 0.57 (direct 1.0, conditions 0.0, evidence 0.688). Oxygen level not tabulated.
4. BASS-II [[inv:PSI-25]]: score 0.56 (direct 1.0, conditions 0.0, evidence 0.64). Tested at 14% to 22% O2, outside this band.
5. SAFFIRE-II [[inv:PSI-99]]: score 0.49 (direct 1.0, conditions 0.0, evidence 0.379). Tested at 22% to 22% O2, outside this band.
How the score is built: score = 0.40 x direct fire-safety link + 0.35 x condition proximity + 0.25 x evidence depth (weights adjustable).

canned.q: What do we know about fire safety in a lunar rover?
canned.a:
A surface base will hold at least 30% oxygen. Microgravity tests of solid materials in PSI stop at 22%. 40 tests sit inside the band, and none of them burns a solid.
Tests inside the band, by fuel type: solid 0; droplet 12; gas 28; smoke 0.
Model predictions at the band centre (predictions, not measurements): FLEX methanol droplet: P(extinction) 0.402 [[model:gp_boundary_flex_ext]]; CFI-G ethane gas flame (normal): P(ignition) 0.962 [[model:gp_boundary_cfig_ign]]; CFI-G propane gas flame (normal): P(ignition) 0.959 [[model:gp_boundary_cfig_ign]]; CFI-G butane gas flame (normal): P(ignition) 0.955 [[model:gp_boundary_cfig_ign]].
Gap (Solid materials): No solid-material test falls inside this band. Of 264 solid-fuel tests in PSI tables, 140 record oxygen (highest 22.2%) and 0 record pressure.
Gap (Gravity): There is currently no partial-gravity combustion data in PSI. Microgravity and normal-gravity results can bound what happens at intermediate gravity.
Gap (Tests inside the band): 40 tests with both oxygen and pressure inside the band: 12 droplet, 28 gas, 0 solid.
